title: expected_signature
description: Output contract for intermediate/expected_signature.json (Step 2/2.6, P3.5.D). Derived deterministically from element_mapping.json + classification.json + inventory.json by /mellea-fy-map. Consumed by Step 4 (fixture generation), Step 5 (descriptor emission — inlined as HARD CONSTRAINT), and the R-SEM-SIGNATURE-MATCH descriptor validator rule. Locks the run_pipeline I/O signature so fixtures generated before descriptor emission match the descriptor's declared inputs/outputs after emission.

format_version.description: Format version of this signature document (e.g. '1.0'). Bumped when the on-disk shape changes.

function_name.description: The canonical entry-point function name in the generated package. Per Rule 3-2 in /mellea-fy-generate, this is always 'run_pipeline'.

inputs.description: Ordered list of run_pipeline input parameters. Order matches the rendered signature.

outputs.description: Ordered list of run_pipeline outputs. For modalities with a single return value, this is a length-1 list. The first entry's type forms the return annotation.

schemas.description: Pydantic-style schemas referenced by inputs/outputs. Each schema may also be re-declared by the descriptor under #/schemas/; the field set and types must match exactly.

source_element_refs.description: Optional. Element ids from inventory.json that this signature was derived from (for provenance + debugging signature drift).

modality.description: Optional. The classification.json modality this signature was derived for. Records the basis for the chosen entry-point shape (see /mellea-fy-generate Rule R21 modality table).

name.description: Python identifier. For inputs, must match the run_pipeline parameter name; for outputs, the conventional 'result' or the return-binding name (e.g. 'findings_report').

type.description: Python type expression as a string. Either a primitive ('str', 'int', 'float', 'bool', 'bytes', 'dict', 'list'), a parameterised generic ('list[str]', 'dict[str, int]', 'Iterator[str]', 'list[FindingReport]'), or a schema name declared under .schemas[].name. Optional types are expressed via 'T | None'.

schema_ref.description: Optional. When type is a custom schema, this is the descriptor-style schema reference ('#/schemas/<SchemaName>') the renderer will emit. Must point to a schema declared under .schemas[].

optional.description: True iff the parameter has a default value (input) or may legally be absent (output). Inputs marked optional MAY be omitted from a fixture's inputs dict per Rule 4-1 subset semantics.

description.description: Optional. Human-readable description of the parameter — passed into the renderer for docstrings.

name.description: PascalCase schema name. Referenced by signature_param.schema_ref ('#/schemas/<name>') and re-declared on the descriptor under .schemas.<name>.

kind.description: Schema kind matching descriptor SchemaDef vocabulary. 'model' for Pydantic models, 'enum' for string enums.

fields.description: Required when kind == 'model'. Ordered list of fields the schema declares. The R-SEM-SIGNATURE-MATCH validator compares these against the descriptor's schema fields by name + type.

members.description: Required when kind == 'enum'. The string members of the enum.

type.description: Same Python type-expression grammar as signature_param.type. May reference a schema by its bare name.
